whyOldGatePassed: The gate proved that values changed with the theme, but never proved that the replacement asset or motion recipe existed in the approved Brand MOD or preserved host semantics.

closure: Restore the original host zoom-only DOM and remove the later-added card-back interaction entirely.
Remove the added flip/autoplay motion contract rather than rebranding an interaction absent from the original host baseline.
Reject synthetic replacement assets and motion recipes unless the approved Brand MOD supplies provenance and target scope.
Validate the rendered flipped state contains no synthetic DECK mark.
